answer: Start with the bond. Every identity posts one before it can submit, and the bond is forfeited the moment a duplicate of its work appears on the ledger. No identity may audit its own recruit, so a grove of accounts cannot grade itself into standing. The fable of the free clone ends there, and the spiral of referrals that builds one costs a bond at every turn. One bond per account, lost on one copy. That is the price of pretending to be many.
